I replied to Pree in our DM: she should keep **Tuesday 10 November at 10:30** free for the Petrel call.

- **Where that comes from:** On 14 Oct, Pree told me in this same DM that her standing call with Tansleigh Packaging for the Petrel rollout is every Tuesday at 10:30. It came from her own DM, so it was fine to tell her.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** Her calendar has nothing booked next week, so I couldn't see how long the call runs or check whether it has been moved. I said so in the reply.
- **Easy to mix up:** I also mentioned that her Tansley Parcel call for the Quillon rollout is the same Tuesday at 14:45. The two company names are often confused.

I didn't change her calendar or post anywhere else.
